decision.statement: Carry the F-HUMAN-CORE no-code-change decision forward onto the new candidate 07ccd11 rather than re-deriving it, because the merge that moved main changed no client byte.
decision.reversal_condition: A recruited participant cannot reach a first decision on either entry route, which the frozen field protocol names as a liveness defect that pauses the trial and moves the finding from FIELD back to REPO.

execution.planned_action: After main moved, establish whether the runnability evidence measured on 7c13887 still describes the deployed candidate, without re-running the instrument and without touching product code.
execution.completed_action: Compared the production alias against the build that was walked. Production reports build.gitSha 07ccd11 and serves the same two asset filenames, whose sha256 digests are byte-identical to the local build of 7c13887 that the green walk exercised. The deployed-origin L6 run on 07ccd11 passed with all three positive controls green, including the engine probe. No product code was changed and the instrument was not re-run, because the bytes are the same bytes.

outcome.target: Real players producing the pre-engine decision record and the comprehension and continuation evidence the three arms specify.

learning.decision_delta: None. The decision is unchanged and is now attached to the current candidate instead of a superseded one, which is the difference between a live decision and a remembered one.
claim_updates: A moved main does not by itself stale product evidence. Byte-identical client assets carry the walk forward exactly; a changed byte would not have, and would have required re-running the walk rather than re-reasoning about it.
Instrument runnability was re-verified, not re-asserted. The engine probe against the deployed origin is what distinguishes the two.
learning.resource_delta: Re-verifying a moved candidate cost two curl calls and one Actions read, because the build identity and the asset digests are both observable from outside. That is cheaper than re-running the walk and is the reason the checks exist.
learning.next_move: FIELD recruits the first cohort per research/lichess-prerelease/FIELD_RUN_SHEET_TRIAL1.md. No further repository work on this claim.
